items.question: How do I choose the right race?
items.answer: The Half Marathon (21.1 km) is for experienced runners, the Trail Run (10 km) for those with some running experience, and the Fun Run (5 km) suits beginners and club members. The Walking Safari / Fun Run (2.5 km) is for children walking and running with their families, and for anyone who prefers an easy walk.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: Adults and youth (11–64): TZS 40,000. Jogging and running club members: TZS 35,000. Students: TZS 25,000. Children (5–10) and elders (65+): TZS 15,000. Participants from outside East Africa and SADC pay USD 30. The fee is the same for every race.

items.question: Who counts as a child, a student or a club member?
items.answer: Children and elders are worked out from your date of birth on race day (20 December 2026). Students and club members choose their type when registering and show their student ID or club card when collecting their kit.

items.question: What do I get when I register?
items.answer: Every paid participant receives an official Mwanga Marathon T-shirt, a drawstring bag, a wristband, a race number (bib) and a participation medal. The winners of every race receive medals and prizes.

items.question: How do I pay?
items.answer: After registering you get a registration ID (MWF-2026-…). Pay by mobile money or bank transfer to the numbers and accounts shown on the registration page, using your registration ID as the reference. Our team checks each payment and emails you when it is confirmed. Registration closes on 10 December 2026.
